name: @pipeworx/mcp-catfacts

tools.name: get_fact
tools.description: Get a random cat fact. Returns the fact text and character length. Use get_facts to retrieve multiple facts at once.

tools.name: list_breeds
tools.description: Search cat breeds by name or list all available breeds. Returns breed name, country of origin, coat type, and pattern details.

limit.description: Number of breeds to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_facts
tools.description: Get multiple random cat facts at once. Specify count (e.g., 5). Returns array of fact texts with character lengths.

limit.description: Number of facts to return. Defaults to 5.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-catfacts forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the catfacts pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
